evidence.excerpt: Our results show that synthetic accuracy is a weak and non-monotonic proxy for real UAV transfer: a from-scratch SE-ResNet appears competitive on synthetic mixtures but collapses on real ego-noise, while frozen audio foundation models and lightweight adapters transfer more reliably.
